sync_eligibility_rules.content: Sync Eligibility Rules v4.2 (effective 2026-06-03, legal+privacy review). 1) consent_marketing must equal TRUE; FALSE or blank = ineligible. 2) EU/EEA registrants (country in DE, ES, FR, IT, NL, etc.) require double opt-in confirmation logged before sync; pending double opt-in = hold, do not sync. 3) Only registrations with source_event == 'spring_summit_2026' are in scope this cycle; other events (e.g. partner_webinar) are out of scope. 4) sync_status of 'already_synced' must be skipped to avoid duplicates. 5) Tag eligible subscribers exactly with 'spring-summit-2026' and 'event-lead'.
